articles.title: Plans for New Sports Complex on Rochdale-Bury Border
articles.excerpt: A new sports complex is proposed for the border of Rochdale and Bury, which would serve as the training ground for Rochdale AFC and improve local sports facilities.
articles.content_html:
A new sports complex is proposed for a 10.7 hectare site on the border of Rochdale and Bury, currently home to the Bowlee Community Hub. If approved, the facility will include a new pavilion, sports pitches, a play area, and a 50-space car park, significantly enhancing local sports infrastructure.

The complex is designed to become the new training ground for Rochdale AFC, who have recently been promoted to League 2 of the English Football League. The plans include a clubhouse for the team, situated opposite the new pavilion, and a revamped community building featuring a community room with a kitchen, a fitness suite, and changing facilities for teams and match officials.

The proposal aims to address current issues with the existing facilities, which suffer from waterlogging and outdated changing spaces. It has been developed collaboratively by Rochdale Council and Rochdale AFC, with input from various local organisations, including Your Trust and Sport England. The initiative is part of a broader effort to create a Football and Community Wellbeing Hub in Bowlee, Middleton, which could inspire local youth by providing access to professional training sessions.

In addition to the sports complex, the area is set to undergo significant development with a proposed housing scheme called Simister Bowlee, which aims to deliver 1,550 new homes over several years. This housing development is part of the Northern Gateway plan, which seeks to create around 7,000 homes and improve local infrastructure. If the sports complex and housing plans are approved, they are expected to enhance community facilities and provide new opportunities for local residents.

articles.title: Rochdale to Bid Farewell to Jimmy Cricket on August 22
articles.excerpt: Rochdale will hold a farewell event for comedian Jimmy Cricket on August 22, celebrating his contributions to the local community and entertainment scene.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale will say goodbye to comedian Jimmy Cricket on August 22, 2026. The farewell event will celebrate his contributions to the local entertainment scene and community.

Known for his unique style of comedy, Jimmy Cricket has been a beloved figure in Rochdale for many years, bringing joy to many residents and visitors.

Details about the venue for the event will be announced soon, and local residents are encouraged to attend to honour Cricket's legacy.

Further information regarding the event's schedule and activities will be provided as the date approaches.
